title: Reducing vector search latency
text: Vector search latency can be reduced by keeping the embedding model in the browser, batching inference, using an indexed vector column, and refreshing the index after a write batch. Warm-up and first-load timings should be reported separately.

title: Hybrid retrieval
text: Hybrid retrieval combines full-text and vector search inside seekdb. The application sends the query text and query embedding to seekdb hybridSearch, which performs reciprocal rank fusion in the database rather than merging two client-side result lists.

title: INT8 quantization
text: An INT8 ONNX model reduces model bytes and usually improves download and initialization time. Quality must be measured against the same fixed corpus and relevance labels using Recall at five and nDCG at five.

title: WebGPU fallback
text: The browser should request WebGPU first when available and fall back to ONNX Runtime Web WASM when initialization or execution fails. The UI and evidence must record the actual backend, never infer it from the requested setting.

title: Incremental ingestion
text: Idempotent upsert with stable document IDs makes repeated imports safe. An incremental document should become searchable after the database index refresh, while separate fp32 and q8 collections prevent precision mixing.

title: Safe local demo
text: The local gateway binds to 127.0.0.1, rejects cross-site origins, limits request size, escapes displayed result text with textContent, and never logs the database password.

title: Database backups
text: A database backup preserves stored documents and vectors. Stop writes or use a consistent backup method, keep the backup outside the live data directory, and periodically restore it to verify recoverability.

title: Mean pooling and normalization
text: Mean pooling averages token embeddings while excluding padding tokens. L2 normalization scales the output vector to unit length so cosine distance compares the direction of embeddings.

title: Text chunking
text: Long documents should be split into bounded overlapping chunks before embedding. Keep document title and chunk identifier as metadata, avoid exceeding the tokenizer context window, and display the original chunk after retrieval.

title: Model caching
text: Reuse the loaded inference session for subsequent requests to avoid repeated model initialization. Browser cache can store model files locally, while model revision and SHA256 hashes identify the exact downloaded assets.

title: Quality metrics
text: Recall at K is the fraction of relevant documents retrieved in the first K results. Normalized discounted cumulative gain rewards relevant documents appearing near the top of the ranking.

title: HNSW vector index
text: HNSW is a graph based approximate nearest neighbor index. The vector dimension and cosine distance metric must match the embedding model. Index parameters affect search latency, memory and recall.

title: Tomato pasta recipe
text: Boil pasta in salted water. Fry garlic in olive oil, add chopped tomatoes, simmer the sauce, and mix with the drained pasta. Finish with basil leaves and grated cheese.

title: Train travel checklist
text: Before a train journey, confirm the departure station and time, carry valid identification, pack water, and arrive early enough to find the platform.

title: Watering a vegetable garden
text: Water garden vegetables near their roots early in the morning. Check soil moisture before watering, add mulch to reduce evaporation, and avoid soaking the leaves at night.

title: Bicycle maintenance
text: Check bicycle tire pressure and brakes before riding. Clean and lubricate the chain regularly, inspect worn brake pads, and tighten loose bolts with the correct tool.

title: Observing the night sky
text: A dark location away from city lights helps observers see faint stars. Let your eyes adapt to darkness and use a star chart to locate constellations.

title: Baking bread
text: Mix flour, water, yeast and salt, knead the dough, and leave it to rise. Shape the loaf and bake in a preheated oven until the crust is golden.
